narrative: A mixed tone emerged in global markets as US inflation data eased rate hike concerns. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones are poised to open higher, driven by a record high in Chinese coal-to-chemicals profits and a potential expansion of robotaxis into major markets, courtesy of partnership between Pony.ai and Uber. Meanwhile, Indian markets saw a muted opening, while gold advanced on reduced interest rate hike prospects and Asian stocks rose, with Gen Z traders increasingly turning to ETFs amidst a market slowdown.
